references_and_agents.plan: Normalize durable layout decisions; retain examples as shared knowledge.
Retain layout/scaffolding examples as shared knowledge.
Promote approved stack decisions to always-loaded decision content.
Keep private to the security-scan skill.
Keep thin/read-only; use canonical code-review workflow without owning duplicate criteria.

rules: Normative policy must not exist only inside a model-triggered skill.
Workflow procedures may use routing pointers and check-by-reference, not independent policy restatements.
Knowledge skills retain technique/examples/trade-offs inside adopted decisions.
Skill-private references are depended on only by their owning skill.
Skill names and normalized technique/procedure content remain shared unless a central rename/delta is recorded.
